by J. R. Gharpure | 1936 

Hinduism

Dharmashastra

Buy relevant books

Summary
: This is the English translation of the Yajnavalkya Smriti including the commentaries Mitakshara by Vijnaneshwara Bhikshu and the Viramitrodaya by Mitra Mishra.
Note: The footnotes of the print publication quotes extensively from various Sanskrit sources in Devanagari script. However, I had noticed many different transcription mistakes making the proofreading a hard and faulty job. Hence I decided to abandon the very large quotations (often Vedic literature) for this digital edition. There are many online sources available where you can find such text; however, always remain cautious of digital Sanskrit text as they always remain prone to mistakes.
